title: Full dynamic response-space coupling under standard DBD versus no-under-relaxation
question: For the frozen real-FGC44 G11 stress, how do the complete dynamic G16/E3 response-space safeguarded coupling loop and its physical endpoint differ between the standard MODERATE delta-bar-delta solver configuration and the matched UNDER_RELAXATION NONE research intervention?
purpose: Separate physical coupled correctness from exact reference-trajectory reproduction and solver cost. G21E is a research solver-configuration comparison, not a production policy selection.
fixed_between_configurations: official MODFLOW6 6.8.0 library and pinned Python dependencies
real FGC44 SWAP carrier and immutable origin
duration, K, SS, SY, CHD forcing and groundwater accepted origin
G09D/G13 E3 scale ladder, execution-class rules and 5% adjacent-scale gate
response-space lambda sequence starting at 1 and halving by factor 1/2
one prepare_time_step and one prepare_solve per arm

independent_reference.note: The 5e-10 head guard is an endpoint/reference comparison guard inherited from the earlier live fixed-interface research scale; physical acceptance remains the coupling residual gate. The 1e-12 guard is reported separately for strict trajectory fidelity and must not be used as the sole correctness criterion.

experiment_contract: Run two independent complete dynamic response-space coupling arms from the same accepted origin: STANDARD_DBD and NOUR.
Each arm uses one prepared MODFLOW solve with fixed XOLD and evolving X.
At every accepted coupling head, recompute the real-SWAP E3 tangent through G16 with unchanged E3 rules.
For each outer update, begin response damping at lambda=1 and halve lambda only when the settled candidate is participant-inadmissible or fails the unchanged merit rule.
Settle every published affine response to a MODFLOW convergence report before evaluating the SWAP candidate.
Do not require intermediate heads to equal G17 in order to continue. Record their distance from the G17 accepted trace separately.
Convergence of an arm requires a settled MODFLOW response state and absolute real-SWAP versus frozen-groundwater residual <=1e-15 m/s.
Stop before finalize_time_step; finalize_solve exactly once on a converged arm.
All G16 observations remain diagnostic-only and may not mutate accepted SWAP/ledger authority.
Record participant status topology, accepted heads, E3 modes/scales/slopes, contractions, MODFLOW solve-call counts and final residual.
quantitative_gates: Both configurations report their preregistered NONMETH values (3 for STANDARD, 0 for NOUR).

STANDARD must reproduce the archived G21 outer-1 accepted head within 1e-12 m and the archived G21 outer-2 trajectory error 7.215394948190124e-11 m within 1e-12 m; otherwise the paired solver-configuration comparison is MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED.
Each arm uses exactly one prepare_time_step and one prepare_solve and keeps XOLD bitwise fixed.
No direct X/XOLD setter, rollback, reconstruction or mid-solve state mutation is used.
Each arm either converges within the unchanged MAX_OUTER/MAX_BACKTRACK/MXITER budgets or is preserved as a bounded failure; no tolerance or safeguard retuning follows observed results.
For every converged arm, final |coupling residual| <=1e-15 m/s.
For every converged arm, report final-head error to the independent G17 head and whether it is <=5e-10 m.

Separately report strict <=1e-12 m trajectory fidelity for every accepted outer head that has a corresponding G17 trace entry; failure of this reporting metric alone does not redefine physical convergence.
Report total MODFLOW solve calls, accepted outer updates, total response contractions, G16 logical requests, physical SWAP diagnostic trials and cache hits for each arm.
No ordinary FMR publication-path trial, FMR preflight, ledger preflight or accepted-state mutation occurs during either arm.
Exactly one finalize_solve and zero finalize_time_step calls occur for each converged arm.

comparison_interpretation.BOTH_PHYSICALLY_CONVERGED: Both arms meet external residual and endpoint reference gates. Solver configuration affects path and/or cost but this frozen experiment alone cannot select a production configuration.
comparison_interpretation.NOUR_ONLY_PHYSICALLY_CONVERGED: NOUR meets the physical gates while STANDARD does not under unchanged budgets. This supports a separately bounded production-configuration study but is not itself admission.
comparison_interpretation.STANDARD_ONLY_PHYSICALLY_CONVERGED: STANDARD meets the physical gates while NOUR does not. The G21D path-memory removal is not sufficient justification for NOUR.
comparison_interpretation.NEITHER_PHYSICALLY_CONVERGED: Neither configuration closes the physical coupling loop under the frozen algorithm; response-space policy remains unresolved.
comparison_interpretation.MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED: The STANDARD control does not reproduce the archived G21 path, or lifecycle/authority/comparability gates prevent a matched comparison.

pass_interpretation: PASS means the matched solver-configuration comparison was executed and classified without moving any physical/numerical gate. It may establish bounded evidence about path fidelity and cost, but does not production-admit NOUR, E3, response-space damping, P4, HCOF/RHS policy or solver defaults.
fail_interpretation: Preserve technical and scientific failures separately. Do not retune E3, response damping, IMS tolerances, coupling tolerances, budgets or physical forcing after seeing the comparison.

amendment.reason: A paired solver-configuration comparison needs the unchanged STANDARD arm to reproduce the archived G21 path effect before differences can be interpreted as an under-relaxation effect.
